Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Adoption: Move sign-in step to after adoption certificate step so users build emotional connection to pet before creating account. (why: Sign in currently happens right at the start (drop-off 72.9%). Deferring it allows users to pick their pet first, reducing early friction.)
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Screen: Add a new screen 'new_desktop_controls' before waiting to explain how pets interact on desktop, including hiding and speaking controls. (why: Support mails show users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding (3 emails).)
2: [home, wait_info] Add Interactive Tips to Waiting Screen: Add a tip carousel and progress indicator to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes. (why: Waiting screen in 'home' step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; users get stuck or confused while waiting.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Warning on Sign In: Display a clear hint explaining account persistence so returning users sign in with the correct account. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with wrong/new accounts.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout for Path Options: Switch choose_path screen layout to grid and show estimated onboarding duration. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s, suggesting hesitation. Showing step time estimate clarifies expectations.)
5: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Customization Guidance: Add photo upload guidance and preview examples to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Notification when Pet is Ready: Enable desktop notification switch and prompt user on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: Waiting screen mean time is 2336s (almost 40 mins); users leave app running in background while pet generates.)
